//: TODO(design): working values. The underground is split into biomes: the swamp round the lair, and the biomes of the rings (which ring has which: balance.json undergroundGenerator.rings). ground: share of each kind of open ground (water, mud, roots, salt) in the biome; rock is wherever the caves are not. decorations: what is scattered over its ground (a kind listed twice comes up twice as often; kinds: reeds, bones, pebbles, stalagmite, puddle, roots, sprout, mushroom, glowMushroom, crystal, urn, brokenPillar). encounterDensity: how likely encounters are here (1 = normal). discoveryLine: the line under its name when a hydra first finds it (TODO(design): working texts by Claude). colors: for the placeholder graphics, until real art exists. scenery: how the Big World art of the biome is used once its pictures exist (docs/ART_PROMPTS.md): clumps, the names of its map_clump_<biome>_<name> pictures; clumpsInWater, the ones that may stand in water; propsInWater, the numbers (1-8, as in the prompt) of the props of map_props_<biome> that stand in water, the others stand on dry ground; glowingProps, the props that give off light in the biome's glow colour.

lairSwamp.discoveryLine: Home. It smells of home, which is to say of mud, eggs and old victories.

floodedCaves.discoveryLine: Black water, still as a held breath. Somewhere under it, a bell that no longer rings.

rootTangle.discoveryLine: The roots of the world above came down to see what was here. They never left.

oldCrypts.discoveryLine: The Order buried its saints here, with full honours. Not deep enough.

saltMines.discoveryLine: Men cut salt here to keep things from rotting. The salt outlasted the men.

surface.//: TODO(design): M4, the land above (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.6, §9). Its ground is laid out by the surface's own generator (surface.json), not by these shares; they only tell which ground looks it has.
surface.discoveryLine: The sky. Very large, and full of the Order.

fungalDeeps.discoveryLine: Everything here is eating everything else, very slowly, and glowing about it.
